output.reason: The linked PR [ev-2955a2390de6][ev-a95dca88b623] says installing a provider with a DeploymentRuntimeConfig was "currently broken on main". It shows this on a development build (v1.21.0-rc.0.163…), where duplicate /tls volumeMounts made the Deployment invalid. The DeepCopy change in one file [ev-c8ee24a21df6] fixes that bug. The evidence describes a regression that existed only on main before the release, so it shows no operator-visible change to verify when upgrading from a released version. The proposed behavior-change rests on an internal detail ("no longer shares underlying objects"), so I am correcting the kind to none (informational).

correction.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 deep-copies the DeploymentRuntimeConfig deployment template spec when building a provider runtime Deployment. This fixes a main-branch regression in which duplicate /tls volumeMounts made the Deployment invalid. Operators do not need to do anything.

consequence.statement: Internal fix for a bug the PR reports only on the main branch (a development build): provider runtime Deployments built from a DeploymentRuntimeConfig were rejected for duplicate /tls/client and /tls/server mountPaths. The fix ships with 2.0.0, and an operator who does nothing is not affected.
